crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” Yahweh appointed a sign…
“ ‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to…
then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
who say, ‘Stay by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you.’ These are smoke in my nose, a fire that…
You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after…
“Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to…
at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Yahweh. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

translations.web: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
translations.bsb: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
translations.kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
translations.asv: And render unto our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
